title: Normalize Lab Kind Terminology
description: A special kind of files are labs. Labs contain tests. A test is a kind of definition. Around the codebase the term tests used for test files should be labs. Refactor naming and behavior accordingly, extend existing tests, and ensure compatibility across list/tree/rendering and model mappings.
summary: Normalized file-kind terminology from test to lab across CLI and VS Code filter surfaces; updated derivation, flags, GraphQL enum, emoji mapping, and existing tests.
